description: This file defines the LeavePeriodService class, which manages leave period calculations, retrievals, and related logic within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It includes methods for generating leave periods, fetching current periods, handling date ranges, and interacting with the LeavePeriodDao data access object.

classes.name: LeavePeriodService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing leave periods, including their generation, retrieval, and normalization within the HRM system.

methods.name: getLeavePeriodDao
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns the LeavePeriodDao object for data access operations.

methods.name: getListOfMonths
methods.description: Returns an array of month names in a year.

methods.name: getMonthNumberList
methods.description: Returns an array of integers representing months 1 through 12.

methods.name: getListOfDates
methods.description: Provides an array of valid dates for a specified month, considering leap years for February.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Fetches the latest leave period start date and month, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: _getLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of leave period history entries, with optional cache refresh.

methods.name: getGeneratedLeavePeriodList
methods.description: Generates a list of leave periods up to a specified date, calculating start and end dates based on history.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriodByDate
methods.description: Returns the leave period that includes a specific date.

methods.name: getCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the current leave period based on configuration if defined.

methods.name: getNormalizedCurrentLeavePeriod
methods.description: Returns the normalized representation of the current leave period, suitable for external usage.

methods.name: getMaxAllowedLeavePeriodEndDate
methods.description: Provides the maximum allowed end date for a leave period, if defined.
